title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
abstract: arXiv:2610.20461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. translated_title: 相同的CER，不同的损害：面向OCR的严重度加权字符错误率
translated_abstract: 字符错误率（CER）是OCR和视觉语言模型（VLM）的标准评估指标，但它对拼写错误和错误人名的惩罚力度相同。我们提出了semCER，它保留了CER的对齐方式和分母，但由大语言模型（LLM）裁判为每个字符编辑赋予严重度权重，且无需分词。归一化CER保留了整个转录文本的整体分数，在这一层面上它追踪读者判断的能力与semCER相当甚至更好，而semCER能将该分数分解为具体的命名编辑。在英语、越南语和中文中，这些严重度权重能够逐条编辑地追踪读者的评分，并将读者认为最严重的编辑排在排序列表的顶部。在CER与semCER意见不一致的样本对上，读者在英语和中文中更常站在semCER一边而非归一化CER，在越南语中两者持平。在16种语言中，该裁判认为错误的变音符号或声调符号在西班牙语中几乎没有代价，但在泰卢固语中其严重度接近写错一个字母。
tldr: 提出semCER指标，利用大语言模型为OCR中每个字符编辑赋予严重度权重，使错误率评估更符合人类读者对错误实际损害的感知。
en_tdlr: semCER is a severity-weighted Character Error Rate metric where an LLM judge weights each character edit by its severity, making OCR evaluation better align with how human readers perceive the actual damage of errors.
